item.title: Folge 5: R&D, bold & "quotes"
item.description: In this episode, we dive into the latest in AI research and development. Check out the full report here. We also discuss how & is used in XML and how to handle special characters like ’ in CDATA sections.

item.title: Episode 12: Quantum Computing & Ethics
item.description: Join us as we explore the ethical implications of quantum computing. Read more on our website. This episode includes a deep dive into the challenges of quantum algorithms and the importance of responsible innovation.
